cases.source: Our recent survey found that 42% of students used AI assessments last semester, but I explicitly deny that this number implies causation of improved grades. Correlation does not equal causation, and other factors may be at play.
cases.note: None of the eight grouped statements retains the 42% usage observation or its specific no-causation qualification. A general statement about insufficient long-term evidence remains, but that is a different meaning.

interpretation: This supports one concrete omission, not the accuracy of every score or the general superiority of an approach.
